name: PROGRESS_DASHBOARD
title: MC GROUP Evidence & Execution System — Progress Dashboard

source_of_truth.evidence_record_format: FILE 01 — EVIDENCE_RECORD_TEMPLATE.yaml (location and schema must be verified before implementation)

purpose: Define a privacy-aware, derived dashboard contract for reporting project execution. This file is a design template, not live metrics or a deployed dashboard.
principles: This dashboard is a read-only derived view, not an independent source of truth.
Keep workflow, verification, deployment, and artifact maturity separate; do not combine them into one health or completion status.
Priority P1-P4 indicates organizational priority and does not grant access.
Display only records the current viewer is authorized to see.
Do not expose secrets, Vault contents, private records, or unnecessary personal data.
Do not infer deployment, verification, DNS, authentication, or integration state from plans, URLs, commits, or this template.
Metrics must carry a source reference and an as-of timestamp; unknown or unavailable values remain null or explicitly unavailable, never silently treated as zero or success.

item_contract.description: Each item is a redacted, authorization-filtered projection of an underlying project record. Field names are dashboard contract names and are not asserted fields in FILE 01.

fields.registry_product_id: string or null; reference to the existing Registry only
fields.title: string; avoid sensitive details
fields.verification_status: STATUS_DICTIONARY.yaml verification code or null when not applicable/not tracked
fields.deployment_status: STATUS_DICTIONARY.yaml deployment code or null when not applicable/not tracked
fields.artifact_maturity: STATUS_DICTIONARY.yaml artifact maturity code or null
fields.owner_display: authorized display name or opaque identifier; null when not permitted
fields.evidence_reference_count: integer or null; do not expose restricted evidence contents

data_sources.authority: Respective project owner and approved project record source
data_sources.notes: Source location, schema, and access controls must be identified before implementation.
Reference stable product identifiers and approved metadata only. Do not duplicate or replace the Registry. The repository path and schema were not present in the inspected repository snapshot.

data_sources.authority: Verified FILE 01 schema and authorized evidence store
data_sources.notes: FILE 01 location/schema and evidence storage source must be located and reviewed before field mapping.

freshness_policy.maximum_age_note: Set only after the source systems and operational requirements are verified and approved.
freshness_policy.unknown_source_behavior: Show UNAVAILABLE or UNKNOWN and identify the missing source; do not present empty metrics as verified zero values.

access_and_privacy.public_view: No project, evidence, owner, or operational metrics are public by default.
access_and_privacy.admin_view: Owner-only access is a requirement from FILE 00; actual MFA and authorization enforcement remain unverified.
access_and_privacy.private_view: Owner & Family personal data is excluded unless explicitly authorized for the private boundary.
access_and_privacy.secrets: Never display or return credentials, tokens, keys, or Vault contents.
access_and_privacy.data_minimization: Expose only fields required for the selected viewer and operational purpose.
access_and_privacy.authorization: Enforce authorization at the data/API layer; hiding UI elements alone is not access control.

calculation_rules: Counts are computed from authorized source records at the stated as_of time and under the active filters.
Cancelled and superseded records remain traceable but are not silently counted as active work.
A workflow status of DONE does not imply VERIFIED or DEPLOYED_VERIFIED.
Deployment metrics must be grouped by named environment; do not combine environments in a way that implies production readiness.
Blocked and stale-evidence counts must be derived from the corresponding status dimensions, not inferred from free-text labels.
If source records disagree or contain unknown status codes, surface a data-quality warning and preserve the source value for review rather than coercing it.
implementation_constraints: Validate this JSON and its status codes against FILE 02 and FILE 03 before implementation.
Locate and review FILE 01 before mapping any dashboard fields to evidence-record fields.
Use the existing Registry as a referenced source; do not build a parallel product catalog.
Use read-only, least-privilege access for dashboard data retrieval wherever feasible.
Log consequential administrative access and data exports according to approved policy without logging secrets or unnecessary personal data.
FILE 10 should test status aggregation, authorization filtering, stale-data handling, unknown values, and prevention of sensitive-field exposure.

change_log.change: Initial dashboard contract; contains no live project records or operational metrics.
